title: pathLen tracking using chain_depth counter rather than RFC 5280 full path processing
description: cert.rs validate_chain uses a simple chain_depth integer counter rather than the full RFC 5280 §6.1 path processing state machine (which tracks max_path_length and permitted/excluded subtrees). For the S/MIME use case (no name constraints, no policy processing), the simplified approach is correct and avoids implementing ~200 lines of rarely-exercised RFC 5280 state. Worth defending: the comment explains the RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 semantics explicitly. The off-by-one bug (MIME-6uo.2) is the only flaw in this otherwise sound simplification.
close_reason: P3 opinion/style: no correctness issue, deferred.
